result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback position: Affiliates are covered without even requiring notice, and transfer is permitted to an M&A successor. It also includes contractors, consistent with the preferred position, and removes discretionary revocability. It does not reach the preferred duration position because termination under Section 4 is not expressly limited to uncured material breach and no perpetual, irrevocable treatment is provided for paid-up licences. The changes are confined to licence scope, transferability and termination and preserve the clause’s operational purpose.
